title: Is the INCOLOR SSR the REAL DEAL??

takeaways.text: The XS (48) build with Dura-Ace 2×, ~998 g wheels, dual power-meter pedals, cages and mount weighed 5.67 kg.
Quoted at US$4,600 for the frameset and about US$5,500 with custom geometry in April 2026; the presenter was told the rider weight limit is about 100–120 kg.
Looking at the 28 mm rear tire's gap, the presenter doubted the 38 mm tire figure he had been told; the rear caliper mount works with 140 or 160 mm rotors without a proprietary adapter.

disclosure: Walkaround of the personal bike of Panda Podium's founder, a retailer that sells Incolor; the presenter runs a bike shop and was not shown riding it.
summary: Walkaround and weigh-in of a size XS (48) Incolor SSR owned by an Incolor retailer, filmed at Sea Otter.
